items.difficulty_reason: 14 行、导出内积邻接：取 M 的 K-内射代表 I、L 的 K-平坦代表 L•；compose 引理给逐项恒等式 Hom(K•,Hom(L•,I•)) = Hom(Tot(K•⊗L•),I•)；左端 RHom(K,RHom(L,M)) 由 Hom(K,Hom(L,I)) 代表，右端由 Tot(K⊗L)（代表导出张量积）到 I 的 Hom 代表，故得典范同构、函子性地依赖 K,L,M，取 H^0 即回到邻接公式。承重全在 span 内；1 处引用作导航桩。

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the choice of a K-injective representative of M and a K-flat representative of L, the termwise adjunction identity Hom(K, Hom(L, I)) = Hom(Tot(K tensor L), I) from the compose lemma, and the identification of both sides with the Hom into the K-injective complex using the definition of RHom and of the derived tensor product (source lines 18692-18705)
